'''AK-3 "Reaper"''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[HK-47]] in his attempts to take over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. It was destroyed by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who went on to defeat HK-47.
